messages.author: 20823a3be7eac92d
messages.subject: Bug on position=dodge?
parts:
Hi there,

 

Ignore the format of the x-axis; this is just an example…

This works:

yr2<-c(2009,2009,2010,2010)

ri2<-c(10.231250, 6.460317, 11.7754, 5.453634)

fr2<-c("Eldorado","Inyo","Eldorado","Inyo")

data.df2<-as.data.frame(cbind(yr2,ri2,fr2), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

names(data.df2)<-c("year","richness","forest")

data.df2$year<-as.numeric(data.df2$year)

data.df2$richness<-as.numeric(data.df2$richness)

qqq<-ggplot(data.df2,aes(y=richness, x=year, linetype=forest, shape=forest))

qqq + geom_point(size=4, position="dodge")

 

This produces an error:

yr<-c(2009,2009)

ri<-c(10.231250, 6.460317)

fr<-c("Eldorado","Inyo")

data.df1<-as.data.frame(cbind(yr,ri,fr), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

data.df1$yr<-as.numeric(data.df1$yr)

data.df1$ri<-as.numeric(data.df1$ri)

names(data.df1)<-c("year","richness","forest")

data.df1$year<-as.numeric(data.df1$year)

data.df1$richness<-as.numeric(data.df1$richness)

qqq<-ggplot(data.df1,aes(y=richness, x=year, linetype=forest, shape=forest))

qqq + geom_point(size=4, position="dodge")

 

Error in if (any(diff(intervals) < -1e-06)) { :

  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

 

But this works:

qqq + geom_point(size=4)

 

Cheers,

Leo

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Bug on position=dodge?
parts:
It is a bug. You can see it with an even simpler example:

df1 <- data.frame(x=1, y=1)
ggplot(df1, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_point(position="dodge")

I've filed a bug report (and proposed patch): https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues/issue/157

--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University
